before.title: Solarium
before.description: Real soil, tropical trees, and a fake beach sit beneath a fusion lamp and mirror array. The fruit is rotting in a paradise built for executives. A panel sets garden light priority, while a solarium tide cache rests beneath artificial coral ledges. Water laps the [action:false tide fishing|artificial shoreline].

description_variants.description: The Solarium mirror array burns clean again. The false sun is still false, but its light no longer feeds void-moss across the executive trees. A panel sets garden light priority above the fake beach, where a solarium tide cache rests beneath artificial coral ledges. Water laps the [action:false tide fishing|artificial shoreline].

The fake beach has been crossed. Its sand keeps the shape of Nova's hand like paradise is trying to remember being real. The mirror array hangs above a panel for garden light priority, and a solarium tide cache rests beneath artificial coral ledges. Water laps the [action:false tide fishing|artificial shoreline].

before.title: Security Hub

description_variants.description: The Security Hub patrol is down. Red lenses keep watching anyway, now more nervous than patient, while the service shaft lock blinks green. A security display pairs armory diagnostics with the Director redaction checksum.

actions.name: armory diagnostics

actions.inspect_message: Rack telemetry indicates sixty percent of perimeter turrets jammed during the initial breach because their target profiles could not classify Chorus-altered bioforms as non-employees. The system defaulted to holding fire until overridden by physical force.
